title: WhiteLab Genomics Presents In Vivo Data for AI-Designed Genomic Medicine Platform, Demonstrating Targeted Brain Delivery After IV Injection
summary: WhiteLab Genomics is a laureate of the inaugural French Tech Health20 program, which supports innovation in health technology and next-generation genomic medicine.
body_markdown:
### AI-Guided Engineering of rAAV Capsids: Overcoming Native Tropism Constraints for Precision In Vivo Gene Delivery


May 13th 2026 - 10:15AM - Boston, MA - MCEC, Room 210 ABC (2nd Floor)


Our Global Director of Drug Design Dylan Serillon (PharmD, PhD) presents the latest in vivo results from WhiteLab's ALFRED platform. This work demonstrates what a fully rational, AI-guided rAAV engineering framework can achieve when built to simultaneously optimize receptor targeting, functional performance, and manufacturability rather than optimizing each in isolation.


The data reveals how structural and sequence-level multimodal modeling translates into measurable gains in tissue selectivity, transduction efficiency, and bioproduction scalability.

### Discuss Delivery, Design & Manufacturing with Our Team


Beyond the oral presentation, our team will be available to discuss how ALFRED applies the same rational design logic across therapeutic contexts.


### AAV Capsid Engineering


Rational, structure-guided capsid design to break native tropism constraints and achieve extra-hepatic targeting


### Non-Viral Vectors


The same multimodal ALFRED framework applied to LNPs and polymer nanoparticles for precision payload delivery.


### Payload Design


Modular, de novo cis-regulatory sequences engineered for cell-type specificity using single-cell epigenomic atlases and GRN inference.


### Bioproduction


AI-guided optimization to improve vector yield and quality without sacrificing targeting gains — from design to scale.
